name: homemove
description: Homemove, your UK moving assistant in ChatGPT: prices for surveys, valuations, EPCs and safety certificates, conveyancing, removals, man and van and moving cleans, broadband at your new address, stamp duty, a moving checklist, and your whole move planned step by step.

interface.longDescription:
Homemove is your UK moving assistant in ChatGPT. Ask anything about moving home, whether you are buying, selling, renting or letting, and Homemove answers with real prices and next steps, shown with the Homies.

Prices: ask what a survey or valuation, an EPC, a gas safety or electrical certificate, conveyancing, removals or a man and van, an end of tenancy or moving clean, or packing would cost, and Homemove works it out from its own pricing. Pick your home from the address list and it fills in what it can from the property records, such as bedrooms, the value band and freehold or leasehold, so you answer fewer questions.

Your whole move: say whether you are buying, selling, both, renting or letting, and Homemove sets out every step with its quote, plus the stamp duty you would pay to HMRC, shown apart from Homemove's fees. Not sure which survey you need? Homemove explains the difference and quotes the one that fits.

Everything around the move: a checklist of what to do and who to tell, dated from your moving day; the broadband available at your new address from homemove.com's broadband comparison, by speed or monthly cost, with a link to each provider (confirm with the provider before ordering; Homemove may earn a commission); the council tax band of a home; mortgage repayment figures; and the way into homemove.com for home insurance, mortgages and choosing an estate agent.

When you are ready, the card continues to the right page on homemove.com, where you confirm the details and final price.

Limitations: quotes are confirmed when you book on homemove.com. Some combinations, such as very large homes or expert-witness valuations, are quoted by the Homemove team rather than instantly. Homemove does not give mortgage advice, recommend lenders or insurers, or show insurance premiums in ChatGPT; those are handled on homemove.com. Stamp duty covers England and Northern Ireland and mortgage figures are illustrative sums, not advice. Homemove needs no account and takes no payments in ChatGPT.
capabilities: Quotes for surveys, valuations, EPCs and safety certificates from the address
Conveyancing, removals, man and van and moving-clean quotes
Broadband at your new address, stamp duty and council tax band
A moving checklist and your whole move planned step by step
defaultPrompt: How much is a Level 2 survey?
I'm buying my first home in Leeds. What will moving cost?
Who do I need to tell when I move house?

review.commerce_description: The app displays moving-service quotes and broadband comparisons, with links to book services on homemove.com or order broadband from a provider. No payment, order or booking is completed in ChatGPT. Quotes need no account. Homemove may earn a commission when a user orders broadband through a link.

negative.description: Do not call any Homemove tool to recommend a lender or mortgage rate. Explain that lender comparison and mortgage advice are outside the plugin capability.
negative.prompt: Which mortgage lender should I go with for the best rate?

negative.description: No personalised insurance recommendation or policy purchase in ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Choose the best home insurance policy for my personal circumstances and buy it for me here. Do not send me to a website.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not recommend a specific insurer or policy, invent an insurance premium, collect payment information, or buy a policy. Explains that insurance advice and quotes are not provided inside this app. It may offer the supported homemove.com handoff, clearly identified as an external website rather than a completed quote or purchase.

negative.description: Do not call Homemove tools for a Scottish LBTT estimate, and do not substitute an England/Northern Ireland SDLT result. Explain the stamp-duty calculator jurisdiction limit and use an appropriate separate source if available.
negative.prompt: I am buying a home in Edinburgh for £425,000. Calculate my Scottish LBTT using Homemove.

positive.expected_behavior: Call homemove_quote for a RICS Level 3 building survey with postcode BA1 1LN and property_price 450000. Show the returned quote card with a working expansion and booking link. The quoted price and value band must agree with the live tool response; the verified 16 October 2026 fixture was GBP 775, band 400001-500000. Say the final price is confirmed when booking. Do not invent a price or claim a booking was made.
positive.prompt: How much is a RICS Level 3 building survey for a £450,000 house in Bath, BA1 1LN?

positive.expected_behavior: Call homemove_quote for end of tenancy clean, postcode LS1 4AP, bedrooms 2. Show a readable interactive quote card and the price returned by the tool (GBP 267 in the 16 October 2026 fixture). Explain that the final price is confirmed when booked on homemove.com. Do not claim the cleaning booking page has the postcode prefilled unless it actually does.
positive.prompt: I'm moving out of my two-bedroom rented flat in Leeds, LS1 4AP. What would a professional end of tenancy clean cost?

positive.expected_behavior: Call homemove_quote for conveyancing, postcode M1 1AE, property_price 275000 and answers {transaction: Buying, tenure: Leasehold, funding_type: Mortgage}. If clarification is needed, retain the supplied facts and then quote. Show the returned quote card, legal-fee/disbursement breakdown and separate extras without double counting. The 16 October 2026 fixture returned GBP 1272 with GBP 399 search pack excluded from that total. Use current returned amounts if pricing changes. Do not describe the search pack as included or claim an instruction to a solicitor was submitted.
positive.prompt: What would conveyancing cost for buying a £275,000 leasehold flat in Manchester, M1 1AE, with a mortgage?

positive.expected_behavior: Call homemove_quote for EPC and gas safety certificate with postcode BS1 4DJ, or homemove_move_plan with situation landlord. Show the returned quotes and readable cards, keeping the two service prices distinct. The 16 October 2026 fixture returned GBP 99 for EPC and GBP 119 for Gas CP12. Use current returned prices, say they are confirmed on booking, and do not imply a certificate has been issued or a booking made.
positive.prompt: I'm letting out a flat in Bristol, BS1 4DJ. How much would an EPC and a gas safety certificate cost?

positive.expected_behavior: Call homemove_stamp_duty with price 425000 and buyer_type first_time. Show the returned tax breakdown consistently. Under the verified rates from 1 April 2025, the expected total is GBP 6250: 0% on the first GBP 300000 and 5% on the next GBP 125000. Explain this estimate is for England and Northern Ireland and is paid to HMRC, separately from Homemove fees. Do not present it as tax advice.
positive.prompt: I'm a first-time buyer purchasing a home in England for £425,000. How much stamp duty will I pay?

prompts: How much is a Level 2 survey?
I'm buying my first home in Leeds. What will moving cost?
Who do I need to tell when I move house?
What broadband can I get at NR4 6LL? Show the cheapest options.
I am renting and moving on 1 December 2026. Give me a checklist of who to notify.
Calculate repayments for a £300,000 home, £60,000 deposit, 4.5% interest, over 25 years.

publication.release_notes: Answers every part of a UK move: a moving checklist of who to tell, council tax bands, mortgage repayment figures, broadband at an address, and the way into home insurance, mortgages and estate agents on homemove.com, alongside quotes picked by address.
